snippet.title: Living With a Little Fox Girl - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Store: https://saikeystudios.com/product/living-with-a-little-fox-girl/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3845600/Living_With_a_Little_Fox_Girl/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post

Care for a local shrine and befriend Mao, the fox girl who lives there. In this light-hearted simulation game, you’ll have 30 days to balance your time between your tasks and building a relationship with Mao. Use your time wisely, and who knows? Maybe she'll let you stay longer.
